# Lumela 0.1.0: beautiful screenshots in seconds

The first public release of **Lumela**, a free and open-source screenshot tool for **Windows, macOS and Linux**.

Take a screenshot and Lumela turns it into something you are happy to share: a matching background, balanced padding, rounded corners and a soft shadow, applied automatically. Point things out with arrows and text, and hide emails, card numbers, IP addresses and API keys **with one click** before anyone sees them.

No account, no subscription, no watermark, no telemetry. Everything runs on your computer.

## ✨ Highlights

- **📸 Capture anything**: an area, a window (press <kbd>Space</kbd> while capturing) or the full screen, with global shortcuts and a tray menu. Or paste, open or drop an image.
- **🎨 Beautiful by default**: automatic background from your screenshot's colours, auto-balance, gradients, your own image or wallpaper, padding, corners and shadow.
- **📐 Ready for social media**: one-click sizes for X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube, plus 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 and more.
- **✏️ Annotate**: arrows (straight, curved, double), text, rectangles, ellipses and highlights, with full undo/redo.
- **🛡️ Auto redact**: Lumela reads the text on your screenshot and covers emails, credit card numbers, IP addresses and API keys. Pixelate, blur or solid.
- **🔤 Copy text from images**: select words on any screenshot and copy them (on-device OCR).
- **📤 Share fast**: copy, save, or drag the result straight into Slack, a chat or a document. Lossless PNG compression keeps files small.
- **🗂️ Stay organised**: presets for your favourite look, a history of past screenshots with their edits, and your own shortcuts.
- **🌍 English and Turkish**, with more languages welcome.

## ⬇️ Download

| Your system | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Lumela_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `Lumela_0.1.0_x64_en-US.msi` |
| **macOS 10.15+** (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Lumela_0.1.0_universal.dmg` |
| **Linux** (x64) | `Lumela_0.1.0_amd64.AppImage` or `Lumela_0.1.0_amd64.deb` |

Files are listed under **Assets** below. Lumela keeps itself up to date from here on, and every update is signature-checked.

### First launch

The installers are not code-signed yet, so your system may ask for confirmation once:

- **Windows**: in the SmartScreen window, click *More info* → *Run anyway*.
- **macOS**: right-click Lumela in Applications → *Open* → *Open*. Then allow **Screen Recording** when asked (System Settings → Privacy & Security), and restart Lumela.
- **Linux**: for text recognition and auto redact, install Tesseract: `sudo apt install tesseract-ocr`. On Wayland, capture goes through your desktop's screenshot portal; window mode is X11-only.

## ⌨️ Get started in 10 seconds

1. Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>2</kbd> (<kbd>Cmd</kbd> on macOS) and drag over what you want.
2. Pick a background on the right; Lumela has already balanced and framed it.
3. Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd> and paste it anywhere.
